page: Running Hono on Netlify Edge Functions with Deno and TypeScript. Static hosting and serverless backend. Edge Functions enable dynamic pages. Netlify CLI for deployment. Setup: npm create hono@latest my-app, select netlify template. Hello World: Hono from jsr:@hono/hono, handle from jsr:@hono/hono/netlify, export default handle(app). Run: netlify dev, access http://localhost:8888. Deploy: netlify deploy --prod. Context access: c.env.context for Netlify Context object. Bindings type: { context: Context } from edge.netlify.com. Access geolocation data: c.env.context.geo.country?.name. Questions: How do I set up Netlify? How do I deploy? How do I access context? How do I get geolocation?

sections.manifest: Netlify Edge Functions setup. Create: npm create hono@latest my-app, select netlify template (yarn, pnpm, bun, deno variants). Move to: cd my-app. Netlify CLI needed for deployment. Questions: How do I create project? Which template?

Hello World on Netlify Edge. File: netlify/edge-functions/index.ts. Imports: Hono from jsr:@hono/hono, handle from jsr:@hono/hono/netlify. Code: new Hono(), app.get('/', (c) => c.text('Hello Hono!')), export default handle(app). JSR imports (not npm). Questions: What's the entry file? Why JSR? How do I export?
Development server. Command: netlify dev runs Netlify dev server. Access: http://localhost:8888 in browser. Local development ready. Questions: How do I run dev? What's the port?
Deployment to Netlify. Command: netlify deploy --prod publishes to production. Simple one-command deployment. Requires Netlify CLI. Questions: How do I deploy? What does --prod do?

Netlify Context access via bindings. Type: Context from 'https://edge.netlify.com/'. Bindings: { context: Context }. Hono type: new Hono<Env>. Access via c.env.context. Data available: geo.country.name (geolocation). Example: return c.json({ 'You are in': c.env.context.geo.country?.name }). Questions: How do I type Context? How do I access geolocation? What data's available?
